name: ai-browser-agent
description: Lets the agent control your real Chrome (read pages, click, fill forms, tabs, screenshots) through a local MCP server and a Chrome extension, without Playwright.

interface.shortDescription: Control your real Chrome from Codex
interface.longDescription: A local MCP server and a Chrome extension let Codex read pages, click, fill forms, manage tabs and take screenshots in the Chrome you already use, with an on/off switch and a domain blocklist.
defaultPrompt: Open example.com in Chrome and tell me what is on the page.
